title: glyceria maritima var. arctica
intro: Glyceria maritima var. arctica, commonly known as Arctic mannagrass, is a plant species belonging to the family Poaceae. It is native to the Arctic and sub-Arctic regions of Europe, Asia, and North America. The health benefits of Glyceria maritima var. arctica include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of respiratory and cardiovascular diseases. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as antimicrobial, anti-cancer, and anti-diabetic properties.
